ns2:course.label: Veterinary Forensic Medicine
ns2:course.description: This course is aimed at veterinary students. This is a small group lecture and discussion based class where we will discuss forensic veterinary medicine. Topics to be discussed include blunt force trauma, projectile injuries, record keeping and forensic entomology. Students will meet twice a week for an 8 week block. 1 professional hour. Approved for S/U grading only.
